name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Mayrhof
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Mayrhof is situated in Thiersee, Tyrol. The spacious holiday apartments come equipped with a fully fitted kitchen. Guests enjoy fresh farm produce sourced directly from the working agricultural estate. The nearby lake Thiersee invites visitors to swim and take part in various water sports. The surrounding area is peaceful and close to nature, offering outstanding hiking opportunities. In winter, cross-country skiing and tobogganing are readily accessible in the region.
